text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love takes the lead!
Can Admire Groove find an extra gear?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Why... Why, why, why!?
This is the last... the "last" one, you know!?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I have to prove it!
My way of life! That I am right!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (In this race where we've both put everything on the line! I will defeat you...!!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't fool around with me...!!
If I lose here, I won't be able to—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Aaah—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —Thanks for the treat...♪

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I... I won, didn't I...?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... to that person's side...!
I have to go...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Why—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"The final jewel...!
Why did I have to... in such an important race...?!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (What... what was I lacking...?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (If I had been doing that... would I—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Are you saying that the things I "cast aside"...
were what was actually needed...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove keeps looking down, weariness and brooding written across her face.
choice_data_list: Alv...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having said that much, words failed to follow.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —The Triple Tiara is over.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: She will never be able to run again.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: What has been spilled... cannot be reclaimed.
choice_data_list: Still, Arv has won all this time—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
“—To stake everything and lose in the end.
Are you telling me that's supposed to be fine?”

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Please, don't try to comfort me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, Admire Groove wouldn't properly respond
to anything I said until we got back to the academy—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without even a chance to praise each other's efforts with the rival from that fierce battle,
nothing but a sense of emptiness remained.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Admire Groove hasn't shown herself for the past two days.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Now that the ‘contract period’ is over, it might be inevitable in a sense, but...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know what Alv is brooding over.
But right now, she's... in far too dangerous a state. Do you really think it's fine to just leave her like that?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Look at Alvf after finishing her run,
and think about what you yourself ought to do moving forward."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I recalled Air Groove's words.
choice_data_list: —Think about what needs to be done.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I can't just leave her with an outcome like this—not after she faced herself and pushed to improve more seriously than anyone."
choice_data_list: What did I even become a trainer for...?
What did I become a Trainer for...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“‘Never leave her all alone’...
That was supposed to be how it all began.”
choice_data_list: In that case—we've got no choice but to do it!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Is this what you wanted to do?
choice_data_list: I don't want it to end like this...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —The time has come.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Let's go.
I'm going to talk with Álfr.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...More...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...So you were here after all.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
…………Air Groove-san.
Trainer……?
choice_data_list: Alv... let's talk.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Can I help you?
I'm busy right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Busy?
With what?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...You can tell just by looking, can't you?
It's training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Training is only truly training
when it is pursued with a clear purpose.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It's not simply a matter of blindly moving your body
without even knowing which direction you should be facing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: She says it's training.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then what is it for?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: It's so that... I can become strong.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...If I become stronger...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"If I get stronger...
I'm sure this anxiety and impatience will disappear..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: If I get stronger... surely I'll finally be satisfied with myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yet, you are not truly fulfilled, are you?
...No matter how desperately you run.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
—...! That can't be true...
There must still be something missing!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's her ability! Maybe it's how she wins!
I'll figure it out myself!
And if I work even harder than I am now—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Someday, I'll wipe away this emptiness too!
My heart will be fulfilled...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "Put in the effort and you shall be fulfilled"—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Even if further effort is impossible?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't go deciding who "I" am on your own!
You don't know the first thing about me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course I know!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Gah!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I've been watching you all this time—
every step of your journey...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Morning! Afternoon! After school!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Having barely any free time,
and dedicating it all to training!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And she's been enduring training so intense an ordinary Umamusume
wouldn't last three days under it, ever since her debut!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: An uphill endurance shuttle run is sheer madness!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"There's more! On your days off, you carry heavy packs
and hike all the way across the mountain ridges!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, just how many of your after-hours and holiday
facility use requests do you think I've approved?!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Among all the current Tracen Academy students,
there is no one who can surpass you in pure volume of training!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Listen, though... you can't push it any further than this.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If you keep going like this...
you'll—you'll break yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No open road awaits down that path...!
Knowing that, there's no way I can just stand by and watch!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh... No... That can't be...
What could you people possibly understand...
choice_data_list: I get it! I've been watching you all this time!
I get it! I've been watching you all this time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with her physical prowess, her days were
a constant brush with overwork.
It was a relentless battle against bodily limits.
choice_data_list: You're strong... but you can't endure any more than this.
You're strong... but you can't hold out much longer.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
choice_data_list: You still have so much of your future ahead of you.
You still have a long future ahead of you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why I can't just stand by
and watch her break all by herself like this...!
choice_data_list: Don't let go... of that future...!
Please don't... let go of that future...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —...Then—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Then... Then what am I supposed to do...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Admire Groove has the power to forge straight ahead toward a clearly set goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And a path to the future definitely exists.
Now is our only chance to find it.
choice_data_list: Alv... renew your contract with me.
Alv... renew your contract with me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ――...Renew our contract...?
choice_data_list: I'll make sure to pave the way for you...!
I'll make sure to pave the way for you...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Trainer did...?
choice_data_list: I'll revamp the training menu completely for that.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Still, you're the one who told me that my training has reached its limit...
choice_data_list: I'll restructure the plan assuming we'll have Air Groove's help.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Indeed. Even if one has exhausted everything they
can accomplish alone—
Together with me... there is still further to go."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "I have walked a completely different path from you, but you should still be able to find something within me that can serve as your nourishment."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: From Air Groove-san... to me...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. But as for what nourishes you,
that's for you to decide for yourself.”

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will run beside you and show you.
I will show you the way of 'Air Groove' that I forged myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Until you are satisfied,
you may seek what you lack within me."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Think of me as a "beacon," Alv. To open up new possibilities for your running.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'll see this through with you to the bitter end.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Claim the strength that lies beyond—the kind only you are capable of reaching!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
――Everything you have built up until now will not vanish.
So... take my hand without fear, Alve.
choice_data_list: ...Let's do it, one more time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Is this right...? Can I really believe in this...?
I don't know.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (...Still, for me, there's no other... way...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Please... do.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Alright.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm not going to go easy on you either. Make sure you keep up.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —By the way, which race do you plan to enter next?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove probably hasn't sorted out her
feelings yet either. To help guide her forward,
I decided to take the initiative and make a proposal.
choice_data_list: I think the Queen Elizabeth II Cup would be good.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As long as I keep running, I will clash with Still in Love eventually.
If I avoid it, a true fresh start will never be possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's not uncommon to head to the Queen Elizabeth II Cup right after the Shuka Sho.
There's a chance Still in Love will enter as well."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, indeed... That would be wise.
Be prepared for that as well, Alv.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Is that so...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, bringing Air Groove on as a coach, we set our sights on the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.
